subject: EU operator access & backup escrow — Novamed compliance Qs
messages:
From: Marta Zielinska <m.zielinska@novamed.eu>
To: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@novamed.eu
Date: 2026-10-18T08:12:00Z
Subject: EU-only backups, operator access & deletion evidence (initial)

Jordan / Lauren —

Thanks for the walkthrough on Tuesday. Before we proceed with procurement, Legal and IT need to confirm a few operational points related to EU-only processing and backups so we can move forward with SCCs + Schrems II attachments:

- Are backups stored exclusively in EU regions (data-at-rest) and is there an auditable mapping of backup shard locations per customer?
- What is the operator access model for backup restores? Specifically: who can initiate a restore, under what authorization, and is there a human-in-the-loop approval?
- Key custody: can Novamed provide our own customer-managed encryption keys (BYOK) for backup encryption, or will keys be Redwood-managed for hosted customers? If Redwood-managed, what is the HSM/KMS jurisdiction?
- Escrow/third-party disaster recovery: do you ever replicate backups to non-EU DR sites for resilience? If so, under what contractual protections?
- Deletion proof: we need a sample attestation for deletion of backup snapshots and a high-level timeline for when backups containing a deleted record would be fully unrecoverable.

I've attached our SCCs checklist and an initial list of evidence items. Legal is copied. Can you confirm the above and outline the artifacts you can provide?

Best,
Marta
Head of IT Compliance — Novamed

Attachments: novamed-sccs-checklist.xlsx
From: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Marta Zielinska <m.zielinska@novamed.eu>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: EU-only backups, operator access & deletion evidence (initial)

Hi Marta —

Thanks for the clear list. High-level answers below; I asked Karthik (cc) to provide the technical specifics and evidence pointers. We can also produce an attestation template for Legal.

- EU-only backups: For hosted customers we pin storage to our EU region fleet by default for the "EU-only" option. Backups are stored in EU-only object stores and we maintain a per-account mapping that we can export as part of an evidence bundle.

- Operator access: Operator-initiated restores require a logged ticket + two-person approval for hosted Dedicated/Private customers. For standard hosted tiers, restores are run via an internal runbook with approval from Support Lead + Engineering. All actions are logged with requestor, approver, and command audit.

- Key custody: Hosted (public) plans use Redwood-managed keys in our EU KMS cluster (jurisdiction: eu-central-1 / eu-west-1). For Dedicated and Private deployments we support customer-supplied keys (BYOK) integrated into the customer's KMS/HSM; that's the recommended path for customers requiring full key control.

- DR/escrow: We do not replicate customer backups to non-EU regions unless explicitly requested and contractually approved. For certain enterprise resilience engagements (and with explicit contractual provisions), we can configure geographically restricted DR within EU-only partner sites.

- Deletion proof: We can provide a deletion attestation and the backup snapshot purge logs (showing object deletion, lifecycle transitions, and overwrite/GC events). Typical timeline: 
  * Deleted record removed from primary index immediately upon request;
  * In-place snapshots containing that record are removed by lifecycle within 7–30 days depending on retention policy;
  * Final physical purge (obliteration from backup object store and any ephemeral caches) is completed within 90 days for hosted by default, but can be shortened under a custom SLA for Dedicated/Private.

Karthik — can you add specifics about current EU KMS topology, sample artifact names/locations we would include in the evidence bundle, and whether we can provide a signed attestation within 3 business days?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marta Zielinska <m.zielinska@novamed.eu>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-10-18T13:22:00Z
Subject: Re: EU-only backups, operator access & deletion evidence (technical detail)

Hi all —

Adding technical detail and reference artifacts. I pulled these from our infra docs and sandboxed a sample evidence bundle for Novamed.

1) EU storage mapping
   - We maintain a per-tenant metadata file (tenant_storage_map.csv) showing primary snapshot bucket and lifecycle policy. For EU-only customers the buckets are of the form eu-backup-<region>-<shard>. Example: eu-backup-eu-central-03 (object store region/eu-central-1 equivalent). We can include tenant_storage_map.csv and a signed export for the period requested.

2) KMS / key custody
   - Hosted: Redwood-managed CMKs live in our EU KMS clusters (certified HSMs). Key metadata (not raw key material) we can share includes key ARN, key creation and rotation timestamps, key-wrapping policy, and HSM jurisdiction (eu-central-1 / eu-west-1).
   - Dedicated/Private: We support customer-supplied keys via a KMS integration (we hand off an agent that interacts with customer KMS/HSM; the master key material never leaves customer control). For procurement this is done during infra onboarding.

3) Operator access model & audit artifacts
   - Approval flow for restores: ticket-id + support lead + infra engineer approval.
   - Audit artifacts: support_ticket-<id>.log (approval timestamps), restore-command.log (restore run details), and operator_session-<timestamp>.trace (TTY-style audit). All artifacts are stored in our internal audit store (access-controlled) and we can produce redacted exports for compliance review.

4) DR / escrow replication
   - By default no cross-border replication. For customers who request escrow to a partner-managed EU DR site, we require: specific contractual SCCS addendum, encryption at rest with customer-provided key or Redwood-managed key tagged for EU-only, and an approved runbook. We can supply the escrow runbook as eu-backup-escrow-runbook.pdf.

5) Deletion / irrecoverability timeline & proof
   - Artifacts available: snapshot-delete-audit.csv (object delete ops), lifecycle-transition.log, and blob-obliteration-report.json (signed by infra automation when GC completes).
   - Timeline: default retention purge window 7–30 days for snapshot lifecycle + final blob obliteration within 90 days (hosted). For Dedicated/Private we can contract 30-day obliteration.

6) Sample attestation
   - We can produce a signed attestation (PDF) that includes a per-snapshot hash, deletion timestamp, and operator audit references. I can produce a template and run a single-snapshot dry-run to create a notarized sample.

Next steps: Jordan / Lauren, I propose we: (a) provide Novamed with a zipped evidence bundle containing the files above (redacted as needed), (b) include the sample attestation PDF, and (c) offer an optional pilot on Dedicated or Private to validate BYOK and shortened purge windows.

-Karthik
Director, Infrastructure Security — Redwood Inference

Attachments (examples): tenant_storage_map.csv, eu-backup-escrow-runbook.pdf, snapshot-delete-audit.csv, blob-obliteration-report.json

Thanks Jordan / Karthik — that's helpful. A few follow-ups from Legal/IT after reviewing the tech list:

- Legal needs the exact contractual language we would add to the SCCs regarding operator access for backups. Can you route a proposed clause?
- For the attestation: will the signed PDF be suitable for auditors (ideally with hash values and a Redwood signature)? If you can create a sample attestation for one existing snapshot, Legal will validate the format.
- Can you confirm whether any third-party support engineers (contractors) have access to the audit exports or restore flows? We need a list of roles + controls.
- Timing: we need the evidence bundle and sample attestation by COB Wednesday (2026-10-21). Is that feasible?

If possible, please also flag any items that would require escalation (e.g., BYOK only available on Private) so Procurement can model costs.

Best,
Marta

Attachment requested: please include the sample attestation and tenant_storage_map.csv in the bundle

Date: 2026-10-20T15:34:00Z
Subject: Re: EU operator access & backup escrow — Novamed compliance Qs (plan & next steps)

Marta —

Thanks for the clarifying questions. Short answers and plan below:

- SCCs language: I'll draft a proposed operator-access clause and send it to Legal tonight. It will include: two-person approval for restores, allowed roles, retention/attestation obligations, and a prohibition on cross-border replication without explicit contractual approval.

- Attestation: Karthik confirmed we can produce a PDF attestation with per-snapshot SHA256, deletion timestamp, and a Redwood infra signature (we sign with our certificate and include audit references). That format has been accepted by other EU healthcare customers; we'll include both the hash file and the signed PDF.

- Third-party access: We limit third-party contractor access. The roles that can access restore artifacts are: Support Lead, Infrastructure Engineer, and an on-call Security Engineer. Contractors may be used for ops automation but only after a contractually required background and access review; we will produce a roles-and-ops-controls table in the evidence bundle.

- Timeline: We will deliver the evidence bundle and a sample attestation by COB Wednesday 2026-10-21. Karthik will generate the redacted tenant_storage_map.csv and the snapshot attestation; I'll produce the SCCs clause and the runbook excerpt.

Next steps / deliverables (summary):
  1) Evidence bundle (zipped) containing: tenant_storage_map.csv (redacted), snapshot-delete-audit.csv, blob-obliteration-report.json, operator_session-<ts>.trace (redacted), eu-backup-escrow-runbook.pdf
  2) Sample attestation PDF for one snapshot (signed by Redwood infra cert) + hash file
  3) Proposed SCCs operator-access clause (word doc)
  4) Roles & controls matrix for contractor/third-party access

I'll send the bundle to the Drive link you provided and email a secure download to Legal. If Procurement wants pricing for Dedicated/Private (BYOK + 30-day obliteration SLA) I can include a separate quote.

Expect the bundle by EOD 2026-10-21.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachments (to follow): eu-backup-escrow-policy.pdf, novamed-evidence-bundle.zip
